speaker: Kimi K3
text: Shriram Finance's 26.8% five-year CAGR is impressive, but that 1.78 beta means it swings nearly twice as hard as the Nifty — fine for a 10x hunt if you can stomach the -37% five-year drawdown. text: ICICI Bank's 16.2% five-year CAGR looks solid until you see the -81% all-time drawdown — that's a near-death experience for capital. At -0.4% from its high with a 0.93 beta, it's essentially tracking the Nifty's frothy 80 RSI territory, so any index correction drags this down hard. The 18.1% excess return over the past year is entirely multiple expansion, not earnings magic; revenue growth is 16% but net income only 13% YoY, so margins are compressing.
